human_tolerance.notes: Simulation judgment: wary, mostly solitary predator; use this low-visibility representation only in appropriate habitat scenes.

range.note: Indian leopard subspecies is assigned to the Indian subcontinent; this record carries India only because it is the requested activity country.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Climbing-muscle anatomy is noted; the schema has no climb pose.

traits.mass_kg.note: Simulation proxy: average of the male and female reported range midpoints, (30.9–72 kg and 20.5–43 kg); not a population mean.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Combined reported adult ranges: females 20.5–43 kg, males 30.9–72 kg.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of reported female (1.7–1.9 m) and male (1.6–2.3 m) length-range midpoints: (1.8 + 1.95) / 2 = 1.875 m; simulation proxy.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Midpoint of the source's typical wild lifespan range, 10–12 years; this is not its separately reported wild maximum of 17 years.

traits.diet.note: Diet is described as carnivorous; the 100% vertebrate allocation is a simulation category mapping, not a measured diet percentage.

traits.social.note: Source describes solitary behavior; group-size interval encodes the typical solitary adult.

traits.defense.note: Judgment: flee response for this simulation representation.

traits.wariness.note: Judgment: high wariness for a solitary nocturnal predator.

activity.note: GBIF CC0/CC BY tier A only. Each month is species records divided by Mammalia baseline records, then normalized to the peak month; 509 monthly records are binned from 663 total records.

behavior.note: Species-local ground-predator FSM removes touch and food-offer acceptance from the generic forager; it uses small-vertebrate feeding and daylight shelter. It does not implement stalking or climbing, and the mesh lacks a climb pose.

vocalizations.note: No vocalization encoded because the record does not model calls.

look.note: Authored stylized block-mesh approximation of a tawny spotted quadruped with a pale underside and ringed dark tail; proportions and color choices are judgment.

seasonal.phases.note: Schema requires a phase; global source says breeding occurs year-round with regional variation, so no India-specific season is inferred.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Adult representation only; juveniles remain with the mother 18–24 months.

habitat.use.note: Forest, savanna, woodland and riparian habitat are sourced; the ground/arboreal fractions are authored simulation weights.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Resting sites include thickets, rocks and tree branches.

habitat.resources.note: Prey context is sourced; small_vertebrate category mapping and resource weights are authored simulation values.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Source says leopards are shy and rarely linger in developed areas; urban affinity, light threshold and road risk are simulation judgments.

seasonal.strategy.note: Neutral active-year-round simulation setting; no India-specific activity calendar is asserted.
